design_fields.q1_rationale: The study used average plausible values, which does not meet the criteria for proper handling of plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study uses ILSA student-level data but does not mention whether sampling weights were applied.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study appears to analyze school efficiency at the school level without using multilevel modeling or accounting for school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions internal validation methods such as stratified 5-fold cross-validation, indicating that it did not validate findings on an external dataset.
